item.title: Alpine skier Lindsey Vonn completes comeback to earn spot on Team USA in 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: Nearly eight years after her last Olympic appearance and five years after stepping away from competition, 41-year-old Lindsey Vonn has officially qualified to represent the United States at the 2026 Winter Olympics in Milan and Cortina d’Ampezzo.

item.title: Indiana Sees Strong Tourism Growth
item.description: Indiana tourism topped pre-pandemic levels in 2024, setting a new record for visitor activity across the state. Governor Braun Announces Record… A report released Monday by Governor Mike Braun shows 83 million people visited Indiana last year.

item.title: Missing Teen Located in New York State
item.description: Jasper Police say a teen reported missing last week has been located. Police announced Tuesday evening that 16-year-old Allison Alvarez Lopez was located safely in the state of New York. Arrangements were being made for her return
